title.narrative: Support to European Accession of North Macedonia

description.narrative: This project will enhance the institutional, technical, and administrative capacity of the Government of North Macedonia to conduct EU accession. It will support the Government's action to combat corruption and contribute to increased engagement of civil society, media, youth and the general public in the process. This objective will be achieved through support that encompasses technical assistance, capacity building and grant support.
